item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President makes the statutory import-relief determination and specifies additional tariffs and quantitative restrictions; the determination is a present legally consequential predicate, although the measures are proclaimed afterward.","evidence":"I determined to impose additional tariffs and quantitative restrictions"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President makes the statutory determination that the proclaimed relief permits at least the required import quantity; the legally significant finding occurs in this segment.","evidence":"I have determined that the level of import relief hereinafter proclaimed pursuant to section 203(a)(3) of the Trade Act"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines the representative import period used for the statutory relief calculation, a legally consequential statutory finding.","evidence":"I have determined to be the most recent representative period for imports of such articles"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The President immediately modifies the GATT schedule and the tariff schedule appendix, changing the governing tariff framework through this proclamation itself.","evidence":"Subpart A, part 2 of the Appendix to the TSUS is modified as set forth in the Annex to this proclamation."},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the USTR to administer, negotiate, allocate, and potentially modify relief later without dictating the results of those discretionary implementation decisions.","evidence":"The United States Trade Representative (USTR) is hereby directed to take such actions and perform such functions for the United States as may be necessary to administer and implement the relief"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The President authorizes the USTR to delegate implementation and administration functions, an internal assignment of executive authority.","evidence":"the USTR is hereby authorized to delegate to appropriate officials or agencies of the United States authority"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The segment assigns discretionary implementation, regulatory, consultation, review, recommendation, and interagency-organizing functions to executive officials; it does not dictate a particular later legal outcome.","evidence":"The USTR is directed to conduct an annual review of the necessity for and effectiveness of such relief"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of the Treasury to undertake lawful implementation actions whose content is to be determined by the USTR, making this discretionary executive implementation.","evidence":"The Secretary of the Treasury shall take such actions"},{"segment_id":"9","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably contains both continuation of a discretionary USTR-determined implementation instruction and a self-executing provision fixing the proclamation's legally operative period.","evidence":"This proclamation shall be effective with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after July 20, 1983, and before the close of July 19, 1987"}]}
